endpointCertification: Reconcile all stored cash events and quantities. Certify only exact scheduled 15:30 post-event snapshots with zero open and zero unresolved positions, valid equity==cash, no external flows. Otherwise EOD=null. No mark, fill, trade, or price is created.
dailyReturn: 100*(certifiedEOD[t]/certifiedEOD[t-1]-1); initial cash is initial endpoint. A missing daily endpoint invalidates its two adjacent daily ratios, not later independent pairs. Do not remove missing sessions or splice valid days.
endpointReturn: 100*(certifiedFinalEOD/initialCash-1) if final endpoint is certified; this is a NEW supplemental endpoint metric, never the frozen all-event fullEquity field.
geometricDaily: If final endpoint is certified and no external flows, use full scheduled session count N, never number of surviving valid days. Arithmetic/median daily statistics require every scheduled daily return.
drawdown: End-of-day maximum drawdown on complete certified EOD series plus initial equity only. Intraday all-event MaxDD remains null whenever any source valuation is null; never relabel EOD MaxDD as intraday MaxDD.
rankingAudit: Reproduce existing tables without reselection. Diagnose fixed Top3 Gate feasibility via totalKnown/(selected-maxUnknown). This is a loose upper bound, not a tradable policy. Keep v2 NO_SELECTION_STOP.
completionNotClaimed: Supplemental reporting implementation can pass independently. Neither capital strategy completion nor full six-curve valuation completion follows from this audit.
